import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
d = df.dropna(subset=['recovery_score']).copy()
for e in exposures:
    dd = d.dropna(subset=[e])
    X = pd.get_dummies(dd['hospital'], drop_first=True).astype(float)
    X[e] = dd[e]
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    m = sm.OLS(dd['recovery_score'], X).fit()
    print(f"{e:14s} coef={m.params[e]:8.4f} se={m.bse[e]:7.4f} p={m.pvalues[e]:.4g} n={len(dd)}")

import statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']

The pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data (outcome on vitamin_d plus hospital indicators) gave estimate 0.086, SE 0.136, p=0.529, which is not significant at alpha=0.05. The candidate effect did not replicate, so no direct effect is confirmed."}
